title: Machine Learning and Statistical Approaches to Measuring Similarity of Political Parties

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating automated natural language processing and textual similarity measures (such as transformer-based models, stylometry, and word embeddings) as a reproducible alternative to measure party similarity, aiming to overcome the subjectivity and coder bias present in traditional human expert surveys and manual document coding.

Measuring the ideological positions and similarities of political parties by analyzing their electoral programs and manifestos using automated text scaling algorithms, and benchmarking the results against expert surveys, roll-call voting records, and coalition patterns.
